description.value: You know Detect Magic and Identify and can cast them as rituals without material components.
Double your proficiency bonus for ability checks using tool proficiencies gained from this class.

During a long rest, you can transfer a +1, +2, or +3 weapon bonus into an Inventor weapon, destroying the original weapon. You can also convert magically-bonused armor to a lighter armor type. Only the numeric attack/damage or AC bonus transfers unless your GM permits another retrofit.

You cast Inventor spells using Intelligence. Spell save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier; spell attack modifier = proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier. You may use an arcane focus. You regain expended Inventor spell slots on a long rest. Use the Inventor spell list; this patch tags the stock 5e2024 spells from that list as Inventor spells.

You learn Mending and can cast it at will. You also learn Cure Wounds (or another Inventor spell if you already know it). Constructs targeted by your Cure Wounds can regain hit points normally.

Choose one cross-disciplinary creation. This is separate from your normal specialization upgrade slots. The selected option can be changed here if your GM allows you to rebuild it under the source rules.
Create a device that can cast Shatter or Thunderburst Mine without a spell slot; once used, it recharges on a short or long rest.
Create a belt that can cast Enlarge/Reduce on yourself without a spell slot; once used, it recharges on a short or long rest.

Reaction when taking acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage: gain resistance to the triggering damage until your next turn; your next melee hit before then deals +1d6 of that type. Recharges on a short or long rest.
Enhance a Gadgetsmith grappling hook to 30 ft and allow you to drag a willing or grappled Medium-or-smaller creature when pulling yourself to a Large-or-larger target.

prerequisites.value: Requires a Gadgetsmith Grappling Hook to function as written.

description.value: Create a gadget that casts Burning Hands as a 2nd-level spell without a spell slot; recharges on a short or long rest.
Action: target a point within 30 ft; creatures within 20 ft make a Dexterity save against your spell save DC or are blinded until the end of their next turn. Recharges on a short or long rest.
While falling more than 10 ft and not incapacitated, glide at 30 ft/round, take no falling damage, and move up to 2 ft horizontally per 1 ft descended.
Create a switch that casts Fall without a spell slot; recharges on a short or long rest.

Create a finesse, light magical gauntlet dealing 1d6 bludgeoning. On an attack, you may forgo proficiency on the attack roll; on a hit, add twice your proficiency bonus to damage. Add the supplied Impact Gauntlet weapon resource to your character for attack rolls.

Once per turn, add Intelligence modifier to lightning cantrip damage from a Shock Generator. You may also use the generator to attempt to stabilize a dying creature and restore 1 HP plus temporary HP equal to Inventor level, at the cost of one exhaustion level.
While wearing the boots, you are under the effects of Jump.
Create a finesse, light magical baton dealing 1d4 bludgeoning + 1d4 lightning. On a natural 20, the target saves against your spell save DC or is stunned until the start of your next turn.
Create a mentally-operated extra mechanical hand. It can hold objects, make attacks, and interact with the environment, but grants no additional actions.
At the end of a long rest, create/reactivate a construct familiar as though casting Find Familiar without a spell slot.
Nets have normal range 20 ft and long range 60 ft for you.
Use your Gadgetsmith Grappling Hook or Smoke Bomb as a bonus action once per short or long rest.

prerequisites.value: Requires the relevant Gadgetsmith essential gear to function as written.

description.value: Create a light 1d6 hand crossbow (30/120) with a built-in loader. You can take disadvantage on its Attack-action shot to make one additional shot with it as a bonus action, also at disadvantage.
Create a finesse thrown weapon (30/90) dealing 1d8 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing. It can ricochet to a second nearby target and returns to your hand.
Create a device that casts Shocking Grasp using Dexterity or Intelligence for the attack roll.
After a Grappling Hook pulls you to a creature or pulls a creature to you, use a bonus action to cast Shocking Grasp from your Shock Generator at that creature.

prerequisites.value: Prerequisite: Shock Generator and a Gadgetsmith Grappling Hook.

description.value: See through fog, mist, smoke, clouds, and nonmagical darkness out to 15 ft.
If lightly or heavily obscured by smoke at the start of your turn, you become invisible until your turn ends or until you cast a spell, attack, or deal damage.
Create reinforced nets (AC 15, resistant to slashing). A creature restrained by one takes +1d6 lightning whenever it takes lightning damage.
While wearing the boots, you are under the effects of Longstrider.
After a short or long rest, prepare one trick shot with an Arcane Trick, Bouncing, Ricochet, Smoke Shot, or Special Tip effect. This upgrade can normally be selected multiple times.

Animate a melee weapon. While readied, it can make melee spell attacks as part of the Attack action at range (normally 30 ft; modified by weapon properties), dealing the weapon damage dice + Intelligence modifier.
Turn a nonmagical rod-like object into a focus for one non-concentration Wizard evocation cantrip. Once per turn when the rod deals damage, add your Intelligence modifier to that target.
Enchant a weapon. Only you are proficient with it; you may use Intelligence for its attack and damage rolls, and if it has one damage die its die size increases by one step (maximum d12).
Create the Potionsmith reagent pouch and Alchemical Fire option under Cross-Disciplinary Knowledge. Follow the Potionsmith rules for creating, using, losing, and remaking the pouch/reagent.
Create the Potionsmith reagent pouch and Alchemical Acid option under Cross-Disciplinary Knowledge. Follow the Potionsmith rules for creating, using, losing, and remaking the pouch/reagent.

Create a Stormforged Thunder Cannon: 1d12 piercing, ranged 60/180, two-handed, Loud, Stormcharged. You gain proficiency with it and knowledge to make its ammunition if required. Add the supplied Thunder Cannon weapon resource to the character. Stormcharged limits an action/bonus action/reaction to one attack with that weapon; each otherwise-foregone attack adds 3d6 lightning or thunder damage.

Create a Stormforged Hand Cannon: 1d10 piercing, ranged 30/90, light, Loud, Stormcharged. You gain proficiency with it and knowledge to make its ammunition if required. Add the supplied Hand Cannon weapon resource to the character. Stormcharged limits an action/bonus action/reaction to one attack with that weapon; each otherwise-foregone attack adds 3d6 lightning or thunder damage.

Create a Stormforged Kinetic Hammer: 1d10 bludgeoning + 1d4 thunder, melee, heavy, two-handed, Loud. You gain proficiency with it and knowledge to make its ammunition if required. Add the supplied Kinetic Hammer weapon resource to the character. Stormcharged limits an action/bonus action/reaction to one attack with that weapon; each otherwise-foregone attack adds 3d6 lightning or thunder damage.

Create a Stormforged Charged Blade: 1d6 slashing + 1d4 lightning, melee, finesse, Loud. You gain proficiency with it and knowledge to make its ammunition if required. Add the supplied Charged Blade weapon resource to the character. Stormcharged limits an action/bonus action/reaction to one attack with that weapon; each otherwise-foregone attack adds 3d6 lightning or thunder damage.

Create a Stormforged Lightning Pike: 1d8 piercing + 1d4 lightning, melee, reach, two-handed, Loud. You gain proficiency with it and knowledge to make its ammunition if required. Add the supplied Lightning Pike weapon resource to the character. Stormcharged limits an action/bonus action/reaction to one attack with that weapon; each otherwise-foregone attack adds 3d6 lightning or thunder damage.
Ignore class requirements for using magic items. You can attune to up to four magic items at once.
Craft non-consumable magic items in half the normal time. You can also make 1 hour of progress toward a magic item, potion, or scroll during a long rest.

As a 1-minute ritual, expend a spell slot at least as high as a spell an item can cast to restore the charges/uses needed to cast that spell once, provided the item’s charges/uses are only for casting spells.
Cast Detect Magic and Identify at will without expending spell slots. You also have advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks to understand magical traps, effects, or runes.
You can use a magic item that normally takes an action as a bonus action instead. You can attune to up to five magic items at once.

At the end of a short or long rest, create a temporary specialization upgrade you meet the prerequisites for, do not already have, and whose level requirement is 11th or lower. It lasts until your next short or long rest. In this patch, use the separate Peerless Inventor temporary-selection feature under Warsmith to track it.

Construct a Warplate Gauntlet, a specialized wondrous item only you can attune to. Choose one free gauntlet upgrade below; it does not count against normal upgrade slots. A lost gauntlet can be remade during a long rest with 25 gp of materials or over two work days by scavenging.

Free Warplate Gauntlet upgrade: 1d8 bludgeoning, light/special; may trade proficiency on the attack roll for double proficiency added to damage on a hit. Does not count against normal upgrade slots. Add the supplied Power Fist weapon resource.

Free Warplate Gauntlet upgrade: 60-ft ranged spell attack, 1d8 + Intelligence force damage, usable in place of any attack in the Attack action. Does not count against normal upgrade slots. Add the supplied Force Blast weapon resource.
Free Warplate Gauntlet upgrade: gain martial weapon proficiency while wearing the gauntlet. Does not count against normal upgrade slots.

While wearing the Warplate Gauntlet, you can reduce current and maximum Intelligence to increase current Strength by the same amount, up to your Intelligence score before activating the feature. End it at any time; it ends automatically if the gauntlet is removed. This dynamic INT↔STR transfer is tracked as rules text rather than automated because the stock 5e2024 effect engine cannot safely model a player-chosen variable transfer.

Forge one Warsmith Armor configuration. The armor incorporates the Warplate Gauntlet, and the gauntlet no longer requires separate attunement. While wearing the armor, Strength increases by 2 and maximum Strength becomes 22. Choose the configuration below and add its supplied armor resource.

Heavy armor: AC 18, 65 lb, Stealth disadvantage. Grants Powerful Build; if you are Small, you become Medium while wearing it. Warsmith Armor also grants +2 Strength and raises your maximum Strength to 22. Add/equip/attune the supplied Warplate armor resource.
Medium armor: AC 14 + Dex modifier (max 2), 20 lb. Warsmith Armor grants +2 Strength and raises your maximum Strength to 22. Add/equip/attune the supplied Warsuit armor resource.
Light armor: AC 12 + Dex modifier, 13 lb. Warsmith Armor grants +2 Strength and raises your maximum Strength to 22. Add/equip/attune the supplied Warskin armor resource.

Integrated medium armor: AC 14 + Dex modifier (max 2), cannot be removed and grants Powerful Build. Warsmith Armor grants +2 Strength and raises your maximum Strength to 22. Add/equip/attune the supplied Integrated Armor resource.

Choose one Warsmith or generic Inventor upgrade for this slot. This slot intentionally only offers upgrades whose level requirement was legal when the slot was gained, so later swaps obey Inventor 2.2.3’s original-slot-level rule. Prerequisite/incompatibility text is shown on each option; RPG Companion’s stock selector does not automatically block every dependency, so do not choose an option whose listed prerequisite you do not meet.
Reduce armor weight by 15 lb (minimum 0) and increase all movement speeds by 10 ft while wearing the armor. This upgrade can be applied twice.
Second application: another 15 lb weight reduction and another +10 ft to movement speeds while wearing the armor.
Integrate deployable hooks and fins. While wearing the armor, gain climbing and swimming speeds equal to your walking speed, and move across walls/ceilings hands-free.
Gain darkvision 60 ft, or increase existing darkvision by 60 ft. While wearing the armor, you also have advantage on saves against being blinded.
Ignore Sunlight Sensitivity. While wearing the armor, you also have advantage on saves against being blinded.
One divination spell at a time no longer requires your concentration. While wearing the armor, you also have advantage on saves against being blinded.
Your armor collapses into a normal-looking case weighing one-third normal. Don or doff it as an action.
Gain resistance to poison damage, immunity to the poisoned condition, advantage on saves against disease, and special resilience against effects requiring a humanoid target.
While wearing the Warplate Gauntlet, cast Fire Bolt. You also gain access through the gauntlet to Burning Hands (3), Scorching Ray (5), Fireball (9), Wall of Fire (13), and Flame Strike (17).

Upgrade the Warplate Gauntlet with a 60-ft ranged spell attack dealing 1d8 + Intelligence modifier force damage. It can replace any attack you make with the Attack action. Add the supplied Force Blast weapon resource for attack rolls.

Reaction when taking damage: brace until your next turn, gaining resistance to all damage (including the triggering damage) and imposing disadvantage on later attacks against you. On your next turn, speed is halved and you cannot take an action (bonus action still allowed).

Integrated 20-ft grappling hook usable as an attack or action to pull Small-or-smaller targets to you (with a grapple check) or pull yourself to Medium-or-larger targets. Movement provokes opportunity attacks with disadvantage.
Integrated 30-ft grappling reel usable as an attack or action. Pull Large-or-smaller targets to you on a successful Athletics check or pull yourself to Large-or-larger targets.
When damage would reduce you to 0 HP (unless from a critical hit), make a Constitution save DC 5 + damage taken; on success drop to 1 HP instead.
Cast Lightning Charged as a bonus action without a spell slot once per short or long rest. Its damage can also apply to Force Blast.
While wearing the Warplate Gauntlet, cast Shocking Grasp. You also gain Lightning Tendril (3), Lightning Charged (5), Lightning Bolt (9), Jumping Jolt (13), and Sky Burst (17) through the gauntlet.
Gain proficiency with martial weapons while wearing the Warplate Gauntlet.

Your empty Warplate Gauntlet becomes a light, special melee weapon dealing 1d8 bludgeoning. Before an attack, you may forgo adding proficiency to the attack roll; on a hit, add twice proficiency to damage. Add the supplied Power Fist weapon resource.
Apply Power Fist to the second gauntlet, creating another weapon with the same properties.
Increase Warsmith Armor AC by 1. This upgrade can be applied up to three times. The automated +1 AC assumes you are wearing your Warsmith armor.
Second application: increase Warsmith Armor AC by another 1.
Third application: increase Warsmith Armor AC by another 1.

Use the Grappling Hook for your movement instead of as an attack/action. The first such movement each turn does not provoke opportunity attacks.
Gain proficiency with shields.
Gain proficiency with one tool of your choice.

Integrate a shield into one arm. You are proficient with it and deploy it as a bonus action; the arm is occupied while deployed. Shoving a Medium-or-smaller creature with it deals Strength modifier damage.

You gain the bonus upgrade slot shown separately. During a long rest, you can swap one upgrade for another valid upgrade of the same original slot level, provided you do not break a prerequisite or incompatibility.

Track your temporary Peerless Inventor upgrade here. Choose an eligible Warsmith/generic upgrade with an 11th-level-or-lower requirement that you do not already have. Change it after a short or long rest. This selector does not auto-clear on rest.
Reduce armor weight by 15 lb (minimum 0) and increase all movement speeds by 10 ft while wearing the armor. This upgrade can be applied twice.
Second application: another 15 lb weight reduction and another +10 ft to movement speeds while wearing the armor.
Integrate deployable hooks and fins. While wearing the armor, gain climbing and swimming speeds equal to your walking speed, and move across walls/ceilings hands-free.
Gain darkvision 60 ft, or increase existing darkvision by 60 ft. While wearing the armor, you also have advantage on saves against being blinded.
Ignore Sunlight Sensitivity. While wearing the armor, you also have advantage on saves against being blinded.
One divination spell at a time no longer requires your concentration. While wearing the armor, you also have advantage on saves against being blinded.
Your armor collapses into a normal-looking case weighing one-third normal. Don or doff it as an action.
Gain resistance to poison damage, immunity to the poisoned condition, advantage on saves against disease, and special resilience against effects requiring a humanoid target.
While wearing the Warplate Gauntlet, cast Fire Bolt. You also gain access through the gauntlet to Burning Hands (3), Scorching Ray (5), Fireball (9), Wall of Fire (13), and Flame Strike (17).

Upgrade the Warplate Gauntlet with a 60-ft ranged spell attack dealing 1d8 + Intelligence modifier force damage. It can replace any attack you make with the Attack action. Add the supplied Force Blast weapon resource for attack rolls.

Reaction when taking damage: brace until your next turn, gaining resistance to all damage (including the triggering damage) and imposing disadvantage on later attacks against you. On your next turn, speed is halved and you cannot take an action (bonus action still allowed).

Integrated 20-ft grappling hook usable as an attack or action to pull Small-or-smaller targets to you (with a grapple check) or pull yourself to Medium-or-larger targets. Movement provokes opportunity attacks with disadvantage.
Integrated 30-ft grappling reel usable as an attack or action. Pull Large-or-smaller targets to you on a successful Athletics check or pull yourself to Large-or-larger targets.
When damage would reduce you to 0 HP (unless from a critical hit), make a Constitution save DC 5 + damage taken; on success drop to 1 HP instead.
Cast Lightning Charged as a bonus action without a spell slot once per short or long rest. Its damage can also apply to Force Blast.
While wearing the Warplate Gauntlet, cast Shocking Grasp. You also gain Lightning Tendril (3), Lightning Charged (5), Lightning Bolt (9), Jumping Jolt (13), and Sky Burst (17) through the gauntlet.
Gain proficiency with martial weapons while wearing the Warplate Gauntlet.

Your empty Warplate Gauntlet becomes a light, special melee weapon dealing 1d8 bludgeoning. Before an attack, you may forgo adding proficiency to the attack roll; on a hit, add twice proficiency to damage. Add the supplied Power Fist weapon resource.
Apply Power Fist to the second gauntlet, creating another weapon with the same properties.
Increase Warsmith Armor AC by 1. This upgrade can be applied up to three times. The automated +1 AC assumes you are wearing your Warsmith armor.
Second application: increase Warsmith Armor AC by another 1.
Third application: increase Warsmith Armor AC by another 1.

Integrate an artificial personality. While wearing the armor, your Intelligence score and maximum increase by 2; it speaks your languages and communicates telepathically. The automated +2 INT assumes the armor is worn.
Use the Grappling Hook for your movement instead of as an attack/action. The first such movement each turn does not provoke opportunity attacks.
Action: activate/deactivate camouflage. While active you are lightly obscured, can hide even in clear line of sight, and vision-based Perception checks to find you have disadvantage.

Expending spell slots stores charges equal to slot level, up to half Inventor level, fading after 1 minute without more expenditure. Cast Magic Missile without a slot, spending all stored charges to increase its level by one per charge. Recharges on a short or long rest.
While able to communicate with Sentient Armor, gain the effect of Guidance on Intelligence or Wisdom checks.
If incapacitated/unconscious and unable to act, the armor can cast an upgrade-granted spell or Dodge for a number of turns equal to Intelligence modifier, then recharges on a short or long rest.

When you expend a spell slot, store charges equal to slot level up to half Intelligence modifier (round down). On Force Blast damage, spend charges for +1d6 damage or 5-ft push per charge. Charges expire after 1 minute.

Gain +5 ft movement, +1 HP per Inventor level, and +1 to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws while using Integrated Armor. This patch automates the speed and save bonuses but not the level-scaled HP.
